pages.intro:
Order Desk reads incoming orders, matches them to your catalogue and asks a person to approve anything it is not sure about.

After setup, save your products, customers, delivery addresses and customer catalogue as CSV files in the Knowledge folder Order Desk/Import, then run the automation "Order Desk: import catalogue and customers". Run it again whenever the files change.
pages.title: Before you start

pages.intro: Start in Shadow so a person approves every order. Switch to Auto simple once you trust the results.
